authority.note: This is a bounded research/data-design delta on the existing Trigger-2 lane. It does not mint canonical truth, model runtime, J-Space, HCU, EntityOS, provider or training credit. Re-enter current main before fusion.

teach_primary: context-invariant variable binding across structurally different templates
correct symbol selection under unseen permutations, lexical families and symbols
protect_not_primary_retraining_targets: symbol emission/write axis already measured directly writable
HRR/MAP carrier-space binding algebra already measured sufficient through k<=16
evidence_driven_training_focus.interpretation: The current evidence supports treating routing/binding, not carrier algebra or basic semantic readout, as the highest-value training deficit.

candidate_seed.factorial_per_family: 6 S3 permutations x 3 semantic classes = 18 rows
candidate_seed.class_word_resolution: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN may appear only inside the episode-local codebook. Target semantic class is validator-only metadata and must not be rendered into model-facing text elsewhere.

critical_blockers_before_dataset_admissi: Replace synthetic ATOM_* placeholders with symbols from the verified 46-atom XENO ABI inventory.
Bind exact ABI manifest/member hashes and atom-row mapping for every emitted symbol.
Verify every output symbol is single-token under the exact measured tokenizer identity.
Run trigger2_trainingtrace_family_split_linter_v1.py across the complete candidate corpus.
Freeze unseen-symbol and unseen-template holdouts before any tuning or hyperparameter selection.
Keep target semantic metadata out of model-facing serialization outside the allowed codebook span.
Do not convert behavioral binding success into J-Space causal labels without same-model causal receipts.
generator_repairs_required_from_claude_i: Make the selected S3 permutation causally construct the actual class-symbol mapping, not metadata only.
Require exact full S3 coverage rather than len(perms)>=3.
Enforce exact/at-most-one counterbalance and near-zero class-symbol mutual information.
Replace the hardcoded class-word leakage pass with a real allowed-codebook-span parser and rejection outside it.
Audit semantic-bearing lexical families across train/validation/holdout, not only one sampled adjective.
Use full canonical lexical-family SHA-256 provenance rather than truncated single-word hashes.
Verify ABI row/member integrity before row emission.
Keep the designated frozen template family absent from both TRAIN and VALIDATION.

research_feedback.hypothesis: Fine-tuning that repeatedly forces a decoded semantic class to be routed through an episode-local arbitrary symbol mapping across independent templates should install the missing context-dependent binding computation while preserving measured semantic readout and write axes.
research_feedback.strongest_counterhypothesis: The apparent binding deficit may arise from prompt/token-position or template-specific nuisance structure, so supervised codebook training could teach a new textual shortcut rather than a reusable internal binding mechanism.
discriminators: counterbalanced nuisance-only decoder remains at chance
semantic readability does not materially regress
direct write-axis controllability does not materially regress
behavioral success is evaluated separately from any model-internal J-Space claim
research_feedback.architecture_implication: The same training primitive generalizes beyond a toy label task: Xeno must bind decoded state variables to episode/runtime-local roles, codes, coordinator leases, NODE_RESULT routes, Hyperposition branch identities and compact ClayCode/HyperMath symbols without treating any surface token as permanently meaningful.

next_exact_action: Recover/bind the verified 46-atom ABI inventory, substitute exact atoms into the audited factorial generator, run row-level and family/provenance leakage gates, then freeze the first ABI-bound unseen-symbol/unseen-template seed before scaling row volume.
